entries.logic: Ensures that each commit represents a single logical change. Standardizes the use of prefixes like [FEAT], [FIX], or [DOC].
entries.rationale: Facilitates code revert operations and maintains a clean, readable project history.

entries.logic: Creates a new feature branch based on the latest stable state of the main branch.
entries.implementation: git checkout main && git pull && git checkout -b feat/{name}
entries.rationale: Prevents merge conflicts and ensures development happens in isolation from the production-ready code.
